sources.label: A Morphe patch that adds Catppuccin themes to various apps including Todoist, GB
sources.author: Morphe - Catppuccin
patch_list: Replaces light and dark palettes with Latte and Macchiato; selected tab icons and labels use mauve. Supports the verified 3.3.5 arm64 build.
Replaces bundled interface fonts with your TTF while preserving icons.
